brief: 6 luxurious self-care rituals that cost less than a coffee.

slots.author: Olivia Wilson
slots.subtitle: SIX RITUALS THAT COST LESS THAN COFFEE

slots.author: Olivia Wilson
slots.title: FACIAL ACUPRESSURE
slots.body: Use your fingertips to press along your brow bone, jawline, and temples. This releases tension and brings a fresh glow to tired skin.

slots.author: Olivia Wilson
slots.title: HERBAL STEAM RITUAL
slots.body: Pour hot water over dried lavender or rosemary in a bowl. Drape a towel over your head and breathe deeply for two minutes.

slots.author: Olivia Wilson
slots.title: DRY BRUSH MOMENT
slots.body: Sweep a natural bristle brush toward your heart before showering. It gently exfoliates and encourages healthy circulation across the body.

slots.author: Olivia Wilson
slots.title: PANTRY BATH SOAK
slots.body: Add a cup of oats, milk, and honey to warm running water. Soak for fifteen minutes to soften skin and calm the mind.

slots.author: Olivia Wilson
slots.title: WARM FOOT SOAK
slots.body: Dissolve Epsom salts in a basin of warm water with essential oil. Rest with a book while tension melts quietly away.

slots.author: Olivia Wilson
slots.title: HERBAL TEA RITUAL
slots.body: Brew chamomile or peppermint and sip slowly without any distractions. Let the warmth anchor you into a peaceful, mindful pause.
